interaction.user_prompt: Fix F1 from worktree review: automatic linker lacks worktree affinity
interaction.model_cot: Decision: add a capture-origin fingerprint to interactions and scope automatic link eligibility to the capturing worktree. Origin = SHA-256 over the canonical worktree root path with domain separation (cvc.worktree-origin/v1), stored as a nullable local-only DB column, never projected into sync wire formats. NULL origin (legacy rows) stays eligible from any worktree to preserve pre-upgrade behavior; the time window bounds that exposure. Exact squash/rewrite relinking is deliberately untouched: it is evidence-based, not heuristic. Stacked branch fix/27-linked-worktree-support-dco-concurrent.
